data.name: Blood Ability
data.description: The cruoromancer can choose to scry through a single undead creature he created with a spell modified by a commanding infusion. The undead creature is treated as if imbued with an arcane eye spell (caster level %1).|CruoromancerBloodAbilityCastLVL
